overview: Fefê, a digital influencer who decides to run for governor of Rio de Janeiro as a joke, ends up winning the election.

overview: 200 years of music of freedom, of hope, of protest: The two-part documentary "Sound of Freedom" goes back to the roots - shows rebels, lateral thinkers and peace fighters. From "Marseillaise" to "Bella Ciao" to "I Will Survive," songs have changed the course of history and become iconic signature tunes.
title: Sound of Freedom - Der Soundtrack der Freiheit

overview: In the two-part cultural documentary United Kingdom of Pop, Signed Media pays homage to Europe's mostinnovative pop superpower and presents the main genres, their stars sand subcultures in the form of film essays. United Kingdom of Pop revisits the most important protagonists and contemporaries behind the crucial lines of development over the past decades, reviews them with experts and categorises them. In the course of this process, United Kingdom of Pop also follows up the most important political, cultural and economic events that are reflected in the country's pop culture, and celebrates the open and multicultural spirit that has made British pop culture so great and so unique.
title: United Kingdom of Pop

overview: A typical Gen-Z youth tries to live a normal life after witnessing a tragic accident in his childhood, but the special ability he gained because of the event is still haunting him.

overview: In a distant village in Northern Italy, the events of Alex, twenty-one years old who has lived all his life alone with his mother, are intertwined with that of Doctor Petrov, an elderly psychotherapist with an unusual interest in solving local and non-local crimes. A strange and mysterious object is found, and from that moment everything seems to degenerate into a supernatural nightmare.

title: Петр I: Последний царь и первый император

overview: This 3-part documentary series will delve into the mysteries, myths, and arcane history of the CELTS, and reveal brand new information about the ancient civilization.

overview: The Earth has an infinity of magnificent places that are a great attraction to host every year many tourists from all over the world who fall in love with these landscapes. However, there are also a large number of sites around the world that only a few brave dare to tread and that capture the attention of all lovers of unanswered enigmas.
title: Mystery Places

overview: A range of dedicated professionals and volunteers look after unwell animals and carefully nurse them back to health at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital in Brisbane, Australia.

overview: Desperate for funds, Ferry Bouman stumbles upon a golden opportunity when a high-profile bust leaves a vacant position among Brabant's top dealers.

overview: Living on the Edge goes inside the lives of (e.g.) a group of grey seals, shell ducks and a family of peregrine falcons in the Wadden Sea, a sea which changes completely over the seasons or even a couple of times per day. At one moment, it is kilometers of extensive tidal flats full of life and at another a mass of water with reckless waves; all tied to the invisible influence of the moon and the sun on the tides.
title: Living on the Edge: The Wadden Sea

overview: Adapted from the novel "Ben Yue" (奔月) by Shu Ke (蜀客). Young Liu Shao meets a mysterious man with whom she exchanges her future for three full days of happiness. Initially, she has led the carefree life of an heiress until she became embroiled in the battle between the immortals and the demons. Her involvement leads to the unravelling of several romantic entanglements between herself and Lu Li, the cloaked immortal shrouded in mystery.

Unsung Cinderella: Byoin Yakuzaishi no Shohosen

overview: A series of special shows presented by the National Lottery.

title: Torchwood

overview: ShoBox: The New Generation is boxing's premier proving ground for top prospects determined to fight for a world title, matching young talent competitively against their toughest opponents to date. More than 50 ShoBox fighters have become world champions.
title: ShoBox: The New Generation

overview: Four Corners was a short-lived primetime soap opera that aired on CBS. It is notable as Ann Margret's TV series debut, and for being canceled after only two episodes. The series was produced by Dallas and Knots Landing creator David Jacobs.
title: Four Corners

overview: Captain Marryat tells the narrative of adolescent mischievous behavior during the Protectorate era in the exquisitely crafted Children of the New Forest. The youngsters support the king, but the local roundhead opposition is made up of Stalinist thugs who chant hymns and are commanded by a crazy Leveller clergyman. The story revolves around ideas like loyalty and duty, which even the tiniest kids are shown to comprehend sufficiently to put their lives in danger for their king.
title: Children of the New Forest

overview: Young men and women of different ages and occupations lived in a siege and lived a cheerful and "special" life. If they go outside, it's a hell full of zombies. However, the shopping mall is a safe area full of leftover supplies.

overview: Travel alongside some of the world's most talented tennis players as they swing for greatness and Grand Slams through an action-packed season.

She's forced to conceal that dream because her father is a famous surgeon, Phuri, who hopes his daughter will go on to become a doctor like himself. What's more, Panpan is concealing her relationship with Aitim, her girlfriend, best friend, and biggest fan.

overview: The Deep centers on a research station at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, where a miraculous discovery signals a new hope for humanity – but secrets unearthed on the ocean floor might hold devastating consequences for the world above.
title: The Deep

overview: The Killing Kind follows successful barrister Ingrid, who is used to dealing with tricky clients, but no one rivals John Webster—charming, good-looking, successful and clever and accused of coercive control by an ex-girlfriend. Following the trial, Ingrid got close to Webster—too close—and when she tried to exit the relationship, he turned on her, and her world imploded. Now, just when she is rebuilding her life, he suddenly reappears and tells her that someone is out to kill her and only he can protect her.
title: The Killing Kind

overview: The show revolves around the Deputy Prosecutor Maria Shvetsova and her team who investigate the most difficult crimes in Saint Petersburg.

overview: The Myrtle Beach Bowl is an NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) college football bowl game first played in December 2020 in the Myrtle Beach metropolitan area. Coastal Carolina University hosts the game at its Brooks Stadium in Conway, South Carolina, which has a capacity of 20,000 seats following an expansion project completed prior to the 2019 season. Owned by ESPN Events, the bowl has tie-ins with Conference USA, the Mid-American Conference and the Sun Belt Conference. In June 2018, the NCAA indicated that the Grand Strand area was approved for a bowl game. The Myrtle Beach Bowl was subsequently announced on November 13, 2018, by ESPN Events.
title: Myrtle Beach Bowl

overview: After six months of complete radio silence, Emma unexpectedly invites her four best friends to a holiday home in an idyllic snowy landscape. Here they are finally to meet Emma's mysterious boyfriend Noah. But the group of friends quickly suspects that something is very wrong.

overview: The Johnson family has made a business out of their love for animals by training them for movies. The remarkable Johnson family embarks on thrilling adventures as they prepare some of the world's most exotic animals for starring roles on the silver screen. With Muddy the dog, Plato the monkey, and a host of fascinating creatures, their lives are anything but ordinary. The family dynamic adds even more excitement. Josh, the daring son, thrives on adrenaline and constantly seeks adventure, while his younger brother Peter has an extraordinary gift for connecting with animals of all kinds. The story takes a dramatic turn when the untamed wilderness collides with the glamorous world of Hollywood. It's up to Troy Johnson, a renowned animal trainer, and his captivating wife Jayne to restore order and harmony amidst the chaos. Packed with action, adventure, heartwarming moments, and family fun, Hollywood Safari proves that with determination and teamwork, nothing is out of reach!

overview: Pongkhwan is an architect who believes in green design. She tries to hold up those standards both in her work and in her daily life. She receives a job designing a condominium delivering green design and eco-living. It's exactly her thing, but nothing about it proves easy. Pongkhwan's junior colleague Ted likes to tease her playfully. Just as their rivalry is giving way to a new closeness, Pong meets Tle, a barista who runs a shop near her home. What starts as a customer-shopkeeper relationship soon turns into a close friendship. It seems that their closeness won't stop at just being friends.
title: The Dreamer: Condo/Barista/Architect

overview: The life of a sugar cane plantation in Martinique, over a period preceding the French Revolution until the restoration of slavery in 1802 by Napoleon, which will cause the general uprising of the slaves.

overview: A fantastic comedy about the everyday life of Russians in the high-tech world of the future. A glorious anniversary is overshadowed by a car caught from the pond, which has lain at the bottom since the commemorative graduation. Inside - a corpse and an unusual stone, which turns out to be a meteorite. The investigation, as if into a funnel, draws in all those who gathered to celebrate: it exacerbates old conflicts, confuses the already complicated relations between former classmates and their teachers. Everyone learns something shocking about themselves and others: who they were in the 90s, who they have become and what they are capable of in the present.

Will they be able to cope with temptations and not destroy relationships with loved ones?

Together they are trying to uncover a chain of mysterious and dangerous crimes committed either in the city slums or in the boudoir of a socialite.

On a plane, struggling to face the devastation of losing everything again and starting over, Amy meets Liam Stone, a darkly entrancing recluse billionaire, who is also a brilliant, and famous, prodigy architect. A man who knows what he wants and goes after it. And what he wants is Amy. Refusing to take "no" for an answer, he sweeps her into a passionate affair. He wants to possess her. He makes her want to be possessed. But what if she is too devastated by tragedy to know when he wants more than she should give? And what if there is more to Liam than meets the eyes?
